0022600126.text: The Jazz (1-2, lost their last game, 11th in the West) host the Grizzlies (3-0, on a three-game win streak, 5th in the West) in Utah's fourth game of the season, with Utah at home 1-1 and Memphis 2-0 on the road. Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Memphis is without Karim Lopez (knee bruise) and Zach Edey (ankle). The Jazz trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after Memphis won 123-103 in Memphis on October 21, and the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26.
